title: tooling-gaps: read_file absolute path cannot access Claude project temp directory for overflow files
description: start_spec and start_run overflow files are saved to the Claude Code project temp directory (e.g. C:\Users\...\Claude\projects\...\tool-results\). The read_file tool's absolute path enforcement limits access to the project root or OS temp directory, excluding this path. When start_spec or start_run output exceeds the result size limit, the agent must use the native Read tool (an external tool) pre-Phase-1 to process the overflow — there is no moeb equivalent for this path.
proposed_resolution: Extend read_file allowed-roots to include the Claude Code session tool-results directory (the directory reported in the overflow error message), or add a dedicated overflow_read tool that accepts the session-scoped temp path without the project-root restriction.
